**What problem does this solve?**
A clear description of the gap or friction you're running into.

**Describe the solution you'd like**
What you'd want to happen instead.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
Any other approaches or workarounds you've tried.

**Additional context**
Anything else relevant — a sample entity/script structure, a link to how
another tool handles this, etc.

**Note on LoreFountain Pro:** if this is a request for one of the paid-tier
features (Continuity Management, Entity Graph, Story-Bible/BBC Radio/
Cue-Sheet/Shot-List export), that source lives in a separate private repo —
feel free to file it here anyway and we'll route it appropriately.
